items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Hibber said, 'wait for me, Sonny!' I say, 'Man, it's everybody for hisself.' ... I say, 'Hibb't, as long as you live,' I told him and Duke

ctx.x: I say, "Man," one cat started shooting up in the air. Now, me and Duke, we got to tear out. Hibber said, "wait for me, Sonny!" I say, "Man, it's everybody for hisself." (Inaudible). I say, "Man, I got to get away." So that went over good. I say, "Hibb't, as long as you live," I told him and Duke, "As long as you live, don't ever sing that song." But he conned Duke. Goddamn if he don't sing it in Mobile, Alabama, somebody sang that song. The same goddamned thing happened. I say, "Man, don't sing that, you going to…

If you sing it early, you know, before everybody is half high and they think about all the things their broad's done to them, then they come down. The fighting starts. I say, "Man, don't sing that goddamned song." There were two songs, "Stormy Weather" and that song, I never liked. Never liked them, never.
